description:
EMBOSS 6.6.0 showalign: the pretty text display of a multiple alignment, identical to the program (600 random alignments with random options equal). Every row except the reference is converted against the reference (the consensus unless refseq names a row or a 1-based number): show N (default) non-identities, I identities, S similarities (matrix score > 0), D dissimilarities, A all; '.' marks suppressed residues; similarCase (default true) encodes similarity in the case (non-identity / similarity / all as in the program); order I (input), A (names), S (decreasing similarity to the reference). Per block of width columns (default 60): the position numbers (every 10th, relative to the reference residues when a row is the reference, with -n / +n flanks), the tick ruler, the reference first when it is a row, the rows, the consensus (consensus = false hides it; bottom = false puts it first when it is the reference). The consensus is the EMBOSS cons algorithm (plurality in percent, setCase, identity in percent, gaps: a gap can be the consensus) on the alignment as given (case kept); a lower-case letter of the input is kept lower case. margin = width of the name column (0 = no names, -1 = longest name + 1); uppercase = 1-based column ranges put in upper case, e.g. '3-10,20-25'. The set type is that of the first row (nucleotide: A/C/G/T/U + IUPAC letters); matrix defaults to EDNAFULL / EBLOSUM62; shorter rows are padded with trailing gaps. html = true wraps the text in 
 ...
and highlight (EMBOSS range syntax, a colour after each pair) colours the ranges of every sequence and consensus line with (A3-13c2: 300 random texts equal). Rows are read as EMBOSS reads an alignment (A4-3): letters and '*' are kept, '.' '~' '-' are gaps, '?' '#' '+' are the unknown residue, every other character (digits, blanks, '_', punctuation) is dropped, and rows that become unequal are padded with trailing gaps. A display text above 134 217 728 characters (blocks x lines x (margin + width + 1): a huge margin, width 1 over a very long alignment) is refused with an ArgumentException (MultipleAlignmentDisplay.ShowAlignMaxOutputCharacters); a width beyond the alignment shows one block. sbegin / send (A4-9, 400 random ranges equal the program) cut the displayed columns: the consensus is that of the whole alignment and the numbers and ticks keep the positions of the whole alignment.

names.description: Sequence names (one per row; the first word is used).

sequences.description: The aligned sequences (DNA or protein; gaps '-', '.', '~'; case is kept).

refseq.description: Reference: '0' = the consensus (default), a 1-based row number or a sequence name.

show.description: What to show: N non-identities (default), I identities, S similarities, D dissimilarities, A all.

order.description: Output order of the rows: I input (default), A alphabetical names, S similarity to the reference.

matrix.description: Scoring matrix name (EBLOSUM62, EDNAFULL, EPAM250, ...); default by sequence type.

bottom.description: Consensus at the bottom (default true) instead of the top.

margin.description: Name column width: -1 = longest name + 1 (default), 0 = no names.

uppercase.description: 1-based inclusive column ranges to put in upper case, e.g. '3-10,20-25' (EMBOSS range syntax; '@file' = one range per line).

plurality.description: Consensus plurality in percent of the total weight (default 50).

setCase.description: Consensus: weight at or below which the letter is lower case (default half the number of sequences).

identity.description: Consensus: percent of identities required at a position (default 0).

gaps.description: A gap character can be the consensus (default true).

sbegin.description: -sbegin: first column shown, 1-based (0 = the first; negative = counted from the end; beyond the alignment = the last).

send.description: -send: last column shown, 1-based (0 = the last; negative = counted from the end; before the first shown column = that column).

html.description:
-html (default false): wrap the display in 
 ...
and colour the highlight ranges with tags.

highlight.description: -highlight: column ranges to colour with html, each followed by an HTML colour (an empty colour is red), e.g. '24-45 blue 56-78 orange'; '@file' = one range per line. Used only with html.

text.description: The display text (blocks of number line, ruler, reference, rows and consensus; lines end in a line feed).

errors.message: One name per sequence is required
show must be A, I, N, S or D
order must be I, A or S
Reference sequence is not a sequence name or a number

examples.name: Default display of a three-row nucleotide alignment
